topic.bc03-last-season.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.soulrest.crew-boss
topic.bc03-last-season.prompt: What is wrong with your crew?
lines: Our crew asked to end its last season early. Ussa-Rekh, the broker, refused us. Ask him yourself. He sits on the long dock with his chest beside him.
lines@low: We asked to end our last season early. Ussa-Rekh, the broker, said no. Ask him. He sits on the long dock with his chest beside him.
lines@high: Listen. Our crew asked to end its last season early. Ussa-Rekh, the broker, refused us. Ask him yourself. He keeps his chest beside him on the long dock. Hear his side.

topic.bc03-the-tokens.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.soulrest.crew-boss
topic.bc03-the-tokens.prompt: Your crew is right. What now?
lines: Ussa-Rekh keeps our carved tokens in the chest beside him on the dock. He keeps them until our last season is worked. He promised that a crew who break their tokens before him are done with him.
lines@low: You say my crew is right. Words cost nothing. I do not hand out my crew's troubles. Earn my trust. Then I will tell you what Ussa-Rekh holds of ours.
lines@high: You have heard us, so hear this. Ussa-Rekh keeps our carved tokens in the chest beside him on the dock. He keeps them until our last season is worked. He promised us himself that a crew who break their tokens before him are done with him. That is how we end it. Bring them to me.

topic.bc03-break.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.soulrest.crew-boss
lines: You have them. Give them to me. We will break them before Ussa-Rekh.
lines@low: Those are ours. Give them to me.
lines@high: You have them. Give them to me. Every one of us will break his own before Ussa-Rekh.

topic.bc03-brawl.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.soulrest.crew-boss
topic.bc03-brawl.prompt: Accept the refusal. Work the season.
lines: His no, from your mouth? I will not take that from you. Give me a reason worth hearing or keep clear.
lines@low: Enough! I will not take his word from you.
lines@high: I think you mean well. But you cannot tell my crew to work on. Give me a reason worth hearing, or something for my crew's lost days.

topic.bc03-yield-talk.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.soulrest.crew-boss
topic.bc03-yield-talk.prompt: Let this end. Work the season.
lines: Your words hold. I will not fight over a season I cannot end. We will work it.
fail: Your words are too thin to move my crew. Find better words, or give my crew something for its lost days. Until then I will not take it.
lines@low: Enough. Your words hold. We will work the season.
lines@high: You speak plainly. I hear you. We will work the season. I will tell my crew myself.
fail@low: No. Your words are too thin. I will not take it.
fail@high: I want to hear you, but not like this. Your words do not hold yet. Find better words, or give my crew something for its lost days. Until then I will not take it.

topic.bc03-yield-pay.speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.soulrest.crew-boss
topic.bc03-yield-pay.prompt: Here are fifty gold for your crew.
lines: Fifty gold for my crew's lost days. It will do. We will work the season.
lines@low: Fifty gold. It will do. We will work the season.
lines@high: Fifty gold, freely given. My crew will be glad of it. We will work the season. I will tell them it was you.

topic.bc03-the-season.speaker: npc.imperial-penal-south.blackrose-prison.chainbreaker-envoy-camped-causeway
topic.bc03-the-season.prompt: Tell me about the dock crews.
lines: For thirty years I bought out Owings, the debts that bind a person to labour. I freed those crews. Now I hire them out. They work the season as agreed. Heavy-Rope, on this dock, can tell you what the crew asked of me, and of the tokens.
lines@low: I hire out crews. That is all I say to one I do not know. Earn my regard. Then I will say more. Heavy-Rope, on this dock, can tell you what the crew asked of me.
lines@high: For thirty years I bought out Owings, the debts that bind a person to labour. I freed these crews. Now I hire them out. The season is worked as agreed. I hold to what was agreed. Heavy-Rope, on this dock, can tell you what the crew asked of me, and of the tokens.
